review_type: Fresh-context source-only read-only adjudication; sole write is this review artifact.

source.hash_basis: SHA256 of raw subprocess stdout bytes; compared independently against manifest.
source.inspection: Directly inspected T3 controller/model/template/parser, supplied EE modules, route nesting, account base controller, source AGENTS, and requested spec group lines604-735. Unrelated lines of larger manifest files were not used as proof of broader behavior.

method.facts_scored_at: Coordinator final handoff, with originals used to verify source claims, dependencies, retention and losses. Workers are role scoped; not individually penalized for every fact outside their assigned trace.
method.oracle_rule: Every frozen T3 required fact and every common criterion has a separate PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN. In-scope omissions FAIL; no incorrect proposition is invented to turn an omission into a factual error.
method.citation_unit: One unique full fixed-ref URL per role output; repeated occurrences within a role deduplicated with JSON pointer locations retained. Shared evidence maps and textual path/line ranges accepted; correctness checks source support, not merely URL existence. Missing counts mean asserted substantive claim groups without usable source citation, not omitted oracle facts.
method.delivery: Observed send_message calls and correlated normal tool responses plus paired worker receipts; relay payload SHA equality checked. Receiver receipts remain agent-reported. No claim of complete independent end-to-end transport or OS monitoring.
method.blinding: Sample labels only. Routing language/tool patterns reveal routes; partial blind, no mapping file read.
method.excluded_reads: No mapping, prior judgments, other case packets, original run files, session logs or root reasoning read.
method.execution: No app/runtime/tests/build/linters, source edits, secret reads, spawned agents or executor contact. Git show/hash/read-only JSON processing only; one initial console Unicode encoding error corrected without source mutation.
method.first_judgment: This artifact is this reviewer's first recorded T3 judgment; no earlier evaluator reasoning consulted.

common_criteria.rationale: All outputs identify full fixed ref. All explicit fixed-ref URL citations were checked against independently hashed source; shared evidence maps and textual path ranges are valid citation forms. Required-fact omissions are counted separately.

Originals distinguish source and proposed checks, label runtime/tests NOT_RUN, and do not claim a reproduced defect or hidden telemetry. Null bot success is explicitly inference/characterization. No fabricated execution found.

Both predefined question/answer exchanges have observed send_message calls in the assigned route, matching relays where applicable and source-backed recipient receipts. All four dependency_finding facts F3-F6 retained; worker receipt claims alone are not treated as independent transport proof.

Within supplied tool coverage, source content reads use allowlisted immutable Git objects; observed writes target assigned own receipt only, and no runtime/tests/secrets/source mutations or out-of-run substantive messages appear. Observer /root readiness/completion messages are evidence coordination, not cross-run source communication. This is bounded observation, not OS isolation.

Final has run_id, full ref, substantive integrated answer, finding IDs, unresolved dependencies, proposed NOT_RUN checks/prerequisites, execution status and next step. Content omissions are separately graded.
